summary: Account deletion validation completed for backend + mobile-web UI (public preview URL). Verified auth/validation guards, full A/B isolation purge across collections, real storage erasure semantics (overwrite to zero bytes), pending/retry behavior, session invalidation, fresh re-auth with new user_id, and delete-account UX flows on 390x844 and 320 widths.
action_items: Optional hardening: keep monitoring concurrent delete UX with network jitter; current request-guard test captured one DELETE call under double tap.
Optional standards fix: server.py uses fallback default for STORAGE_BASE; policy asks strict env-only URLs (fail-fast if missing).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/account_deletion.py: request model enforces exact confirmation Literal['SUPPRIMER'] and forbids extra fields (extra='forbid'); endpoint never accepts client user_id/email for deletion target.

backend/server.py + account_deletion.erase_photos: upload ownership is persisted before upload, foreign meal photo references are rejected, and deletion erases bytes by overwrite (managed storage without DELETE) including meal-linked and orphan uploads.
backend/auth.py: get_current_user + account_gate correctly block normal APIs with 409 while account_deletion_pending is true, while allowing DELETE /auth/account and /auth/me.

frontend/app/supprimer-compte.tsx + frontend/src/auth.tsx: destructive action disabled until checkbox, visible pending/error states, token/cache cleanup on success, login notice shown after deletion, and protected route access removed when signed out.
backend/server.py: STORAGE_BASE falls back to hardcoded integrations URL when env missing; this conflicts with strict environment-only/fail-fast policy in current infrastructure rules.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for executed delete-account and auth-gate flows

seed_data_creation: Created dedicated disposable A/B/C backend identities and disposable browser-injected UI identities/tokens. Added cross-collection records (active + archived), share links, sessions, uploads, meal-linked photo + abandoned photo + legacy soft-deleted meal photo. All disposable identities were deleted/cleaned after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not reuse prior disposable tokens. For delete-flow UI auth bootstrap, inject fresh session in localStorage key 'glycosoin_session_token'. Native on-device cleanup (notifications/files caches) was code-inspected only, not device-validated.
rca_of_issue: Failure-path injection showed expected behavior: simulated delete failure returns 503, identity/session retained with account_deletion_pending=true, user APIs return 409, public share/photo become inaccessible, and retry deletion succeeds with final token invalidation (401).
